{{recipe}}

This '''chipotle BBQ sauce''' is really smoky and hot, so if you can't stand the heat, adjust it to your liking.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 cans [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle in adobo]] including all of adobo sauce
* 1 bottle [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
== Procedure ==
#Whisk together oil and flour and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
#Add remaining ingredients and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]; reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes.
#Cool for 15 minutes and [[Cookbook:Puréeing|purée]] in batches until smooth.
#Store in nonreactive container for up to 1 week.
